Container prefixes count toward the width of thirty columns.

> A block quote leaves two columns less for its text,
>
> > and a nested quote four columns less.

- A bullet item leaves two columns less.
  - A nested one four.
- [ ] A task item has its marker on the first line.

9. Ordered items indent by their marker, so item ten
10. leaves four columns less than item nine.

A footnote[^note].

[^note]: Footnote text is indented by four columns after its first line.
